description: Unofficial Hanakuma Chifuyu fan-art companion inspired by TOKYO6 ENTERTAINMENT. Winter twin-braid design with round glasses, navy uniform and opaque tights; simplified braid segments and covered shorts are original drawing adaptations. Nine original motions include notebook bookmarks, a paper snowflake, careful toy-cup placement and a small two-boot hop. No official animation or affiliation is implied.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
